title: Classes across the week
description: A heat map with Monday to Friday as columns and time frames (half-hour, one-hour, two-hour blocks or morning/afternoon/evening) as rows, each cell shaded and labelled with how many courses or sections meet then, optionally limited to CS courses, remaining requirements or sections with open seats. Selecting a cell lists its courses, and selecting a course opens it in course detail.

options.hour: One row per hour of the day, such as 9–10 AM and 10–11 AM
options.half-hour: One row per half hour, such as 9:00–9:30 and 9:30–10:00, for the finest detail
options.two-hour: One row per two-hour block, such as 8–10 AM and 10 AM–12 PM
options.period: Three rows: morning (before noon), afternoon (noon to 5 PM) and evening (5 PM or later)

options.courses: Distinct courses with at least one section meeting in each day and time frame
options.sections: Individual sections meeting in each day and time frame

options.all: Every course in this term's schedule
options.remaining: Only courses that satisfy the person's unmet degree requirements
options.open: Only sections that still have open seats, leaving out full sections

origin.request: Show me a heat map of how many courses are in each time frame during the week.
